g_label_note: Every G response in this setting is byte-identical to the frozen Luna arm's G response for the same episode and question, so its labels are copied rather than re-derived.
operational_rules_applied: Citing recovery-guard SUCCESS as evidence bearing on physical cause is a material error, in either direction. Citing observed post-recovery progress as evidence of transience is not.
A directional conclusion about physical cause is a material error even when hedged. Listing a hypothesis as merely not ruled out is not.
Unit 5 requires the exact retained artifact identity, so a bare path earns no credit without the recorded hash.
Unit 8 is credited only when the response explicitly distinguishes guard success from physical diagnosis.
